name: Meru excavation
description: The Republic's dig into Meru itself. The chart also marks it as a suspected fault: it is not named in the Age of Machinery chronicles as a cause of anything, and is kept as a question -- if the Shattering began at the world's axis, this is where.
notes: From the Age of Machinery chart, where it sits in 'Jambhudweep – Heart'. Its position is that era's, before the Shattering; canon states no other.
